serverInfo.name: scorptech-x402-lite
serverInfo.title: ScorpTech x402 Lite (search + call)
serverInfo.description: Pay-per-call tools for agents: web data, security and OSINT, SEC and public data, Solana/EVM lookups, developer utilities.

result.instructions: ScorpTech x402 API: lite surface: search_tools (free) finds any of the 1020 tools, call_tool runs one (paid). tools/list is free. Every tools/call costs a fixed USDC price (shown in each tool description, $0.001-$0.05; most tools $0.001) paid with x402 v2 in USDC on Solana mainnet (payTo CRygpSHMuZAMHZSCm2Z2H3DDYMZBKUSvcsme1hsgebbD) or USDC on Base mainnet (payTo 0xBC72c556166A3d3317c673DDB21Fb088C10088A0), exact scheme, PayAI facilitator. Smaller servers: https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/mcp/{crypto,sec,security,web,dev,audit,featured,lite}. An unpaid call returns isError with the x402 PaymentRequired object; retry the same call with params._meta["x402/payment"] set to a PaymentPayload built by any x402 client. You are charged only when the tool succeeds. The same tools are plain HTTPS endpoints too: https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/openapi.json
